edit.revenue: Revenue = unit price × quantity × (1 − discount). Freight is not included.

kpis.name: Freight share of revenue
kpis.definition: Freight charged as a share of revenue.
kpis.why: Freight is a cost of selling that the price of the goods does not show.
kpis.pitfall: Freight is charged per order, not per line, so it is summed once per order (order_facts has one row per order).

kpis.name: Orders over 1,000
kpis.definition: Orders worth more than 1,000 in net revenue.
kpis.sql: SUM(CASE WHEN revenue > 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
kpis.pitfall: The threshold is a round number, not a finding.

kpis.name: Days between first and last order
kpis.definition: The span of order dates inside the period.

kpis.name: Gross margin
kpis.definition: Revenue less the cost of the goods sold, as a share of revenue. This data has no cost column, so it is defined here and computed once one is added.
